text: Pursuant to section 170(2) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, the Ombudsman has concluded the report about its Investigation into Toronto Hydro's Processes for Customer-Owned Infrastructure. We hereby table with City Council for its April 17, 2024 session the Investigation Report, dated April 12, 2024.
City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (April 12, 2024) from the Ombudsman for information.
